name: kb-multimodal-describer-closeout
title: Close out placeholder audio/video describers in knowledge-base ingest
description: Resolve the mismatch where knowledge-base forms expose audio/video model selection while the live RAG ingest path still uses placeholder describers that return empty content.
creator: yudi
notes: 2026-04-21 audit confirmed that knowledge-base ingest instantiates AudioDescriber and VideoDescriber on the live parsing path, but both services still log placeholder execution and return empty strings even when a supports_audio/supports_video model is configured. The processor then raises audio_text_unavailable/video_text_unavailable, while admin and tenant forms still expose audio/video model selectors. The new SaaS must either implement real multimodal describers or retract these configuration surfaces instead of keeping a permanently non-working live path.
